page_title: WHU 1-1 CRY | West Ham v Crystal Palace 03/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Michael Oliver is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) sends a cross into the box, but Sam Johnstone comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+4' What a save from Sam Johnstone! Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
90+4' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
90+4' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Crystal Palace.
90+1' West Ham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Substitution. Pablo Fornals (West Ham) replaces Edson Alvarez.
87' Here is a change. Odsonne Edouard is going off and Roy Hodgson gives the last tactical orders to Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace).
86' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.

85' Crystal Palace players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
82' Here comes a substitution. Will Hughes is given a rest as he is replaced by Jairo Riedewald (Crystal Palace).
79' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) for his blatant foul.
78' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the left post! What a huge opportunity!
78' West Ham have been awarded a corner kick.
75' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is penalised for a foul. Michael Oliver had a clear view and blows his whistle.
75' Sam Johnstone pulls off a great save to block a header from Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) after a nice lofted cross.
72' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
71' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) tries to find Odsonne Edouard, but he puts too much power on the pass.
70' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Michael Oliver blows for a foul.
70' Referee Michael Oliver sees the trip by Emerson (West Ham) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
69' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Mohammed Kudus.
66' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is flagged for offside.
65' Emerson (West Ham) misses an absolute sitter after connecting with a cross inside the penalty box.
64' The game is interrupted. Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.

59' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Michael Oliver no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick to West Ham.
59' Great teamplay by West Ham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
55' A pass finds the feet of Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) on the edge of the box and he sends in a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's easily gathered by the goalkeeper.
53' 1 - 1 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 1:1.
53' Crystal Palace have a corner.

52' One of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital stop to deny a close-range header from Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace). The ball goes out for a corner. Crystal Palace can continue in their attacking effort.
51' The game is interrupted now, Emerson (West Ham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
46' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Michael Oliver blows his whistle and signals a foul after Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) brought his opponent down.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Michael Oliver blows his whistle and it's Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
41' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar.
41' The corner from James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) is cleared away by the defence.
37' Michael Oliver shows the yellow card to James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) for a heavy challenge.
37' Crystal Palace failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
36' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
35' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. Crystal Palace are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
35' A pass by Edson Alvarez (West Ham) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
32' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) tackles a bit over-zealously and Michael Oliver blows for a foul.
30' The West Ham players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
29' It looked like the long-range shot by Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the left post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
29' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
24' Half-chance! Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) plays a pass into the box, but Alphonse Areola reacts well to snuff out the attack.
23' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) receives a cross on the edge of the box. He doesn't hesitate and fires a bullet towards the goal. Nevertheless, the goalkeeper had no trouble dealing with his shot.
21' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Crystal Palace.
20' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
16' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.

13' 1 - 0 Goal! Vladimir Coufal displays great vision and sends a pass to Mohammed Kudus (West Ham), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:0.
12' What a big chance! Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
10' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
8' Neat passing move from West Ham in order to create new attacking opportunities.
4' Michael Oliver blows his whistle after Joel Ward (Crystal Palace) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
1' The match has just started.
Crystal Palace will kick-off.
Michael Oliver will referee today's match.
